## Notable Event

Emily suffered an accident and was bedridden for **nine months** on a hard bed. The doctor from Auburn, South Australia, would visit weekly to check on her, as recorded by her sister Jean McMurtrie in *Some Childhood Memories*.

## Family Stories

Millie, as she was known, was the third child of Francis Charles and Amy Telfer. As a young girl she had a serious accident and had to spend nine months lying flat on a hard bed. Despite this difficult start, she went on to train as a schoolteacher — one of the few Telfer girls of her generation to pursue a profession outside the home. She later married Frederick George Barton and raised a family. *(From the Borders to the Bush, pp.131, 174)*
